Packaging.title: Packaging
Packaging.description: A YouTube video packaging saved inside a creator profile (johnny or guido)

userId.description: The UID of the user who created or updated this item

url.description: Canonical watch URL of the YouTube video

tags.description: List of tags associated with this packaging

notes.description: Notes on why this packaging works

favorite.description: Flag indicating if the user starred this item

ProfileConfig.title: ProfileConfig
ProfileConfig.description: Profile preferences for categories, tags, and default channel name

defaultChannelName.description: Default YouTube channel name for this profile when comparing packs

UserVideoFolder.title: UserVideoFolder
UserVideoFolder.description: A user video folder in Mis Videos (up to 10 per profile) that groups up to 5 custom packs

userId.description: The UID of the user who created or updated this folder

name.description: Name or idea title of the video project

UserVideoPack.title: UserVideoPack
UserVideoPack.description: An uploaded custom pack (thumbnail + title) belonging to a UserVideoFolder (up to 5 per video)

userId.description: The UID of the user who created or updated this pack

videoId.description: The ID of the parent UserVideoFolder

title.description: The YouTube video title for this pack variation

order.description: Slot index of the pack within the video folder (0 to 4)

/profiles/{profileId}/packagings/{packag.description: Profile-scoped saved YouTube packagings for Johnny and Guido

/profiles/{profileId}/config/preferences.description: Profile-scoped category, tag, and default channel configuration

/profiles/{profileId}/myVideos/{videoId}.description: Profile-scoped video folders (up to 10 per profile) in Mis Videos

/profiles/{profileId}/myVideoPacks/{pack.description: Profile-scoped custom packs (thumbnail + title, up to 5 per video folder) in Mis Videos
